scripts.build: next build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('../docs')) fs.rmSync('../docs', { recursive: true, force: true }); try { fs.cpSync('out', '../docs', { recursive: true }); console.log('Successfully copied to root docs/ folder!'); } catch (err) { fs.renameSync('out', '../docs'); console.log('Successfully renamed out to root docs/ folder!'); }"
